title: Conduent to pay $80M to settle 3rd-largest healthcare data breach
content_md: Bruce Giles reports: Business services provider Conduent has agreed to pay $80 million to settle class action litigation over the third-largest healthcare data breach on record, which exposed data on about 62.2 million people. Conduent signed the settlement Oct. 16 with plaintiffs in the U.S. District Court for the District of New Jersey, according to… Article Link: https://databreaches.net/2026/10/27/conduent-to-pay-80m-to-settle-3rd-largest-healthcare-data-breach/
